payload._note: PBH (Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc.) is NOT a pharmaceutical company with marketed drugs or pipeline assets. It is a consumer health and personal care products company that develops, manufactures, markets and distributes over-the-counter (OTC) healthcare and personal care brands through mass merchandisers, drug stores, food stores, dollar stores, convenience stores, club stores and e-commerce channels. The company's portfolio includes well-recognized OTC brands such as Monistat, BC/Goody's, Summer's Eve, TheraTears, and Fleet. These are consumer healthcare products, not prescription pharmaceuticals requiring FDA NDA approvals or Orange Book listings. The filing mentions that Walmart and Amazon accounted for approximately 19.7% and 10.9% of gross revenues respectively in fiscal 2024, and the top five selling brands represented approximately 37.9% of gross revenues, but these are consumer product brands, not pharmaceutical drugs. Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated is mentioned only as a member of the company's peer group index for performance comparison purposes (see Performance Graph section and footnotes), not as a business relationship or pharmaceutical product connection.
